summary:
Results-driven Data Scientist and Generative AI Engineer with 3.5+ years of experience designing and deploying
Machine Learning and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions across healthcare, financial analytics, and
digital payment fraud detection systems. Strong expertise in LLMs, semantic search, embeddings, vector databases,
predictive modeling, and anomaly detection to build intelligent decision-support systems. Experienced in
developing end-to-end ML and GenAI pipelines including data ingestion, EDA, feature engineering, model training,
evaluation, and production deployment using Python-based microservices. Proven ability to deliver scalable AI
solutions that improve operational efficiency, enhance decision-making, and reduce manual effort through FastAPI,
Docker, and AWS-based cloud deployments.

bullets: Develop and deploy enterprise-scale Machine Learning and Generative AI solutions across healthcare analytics, financial intelligence systems, and digital payment fraud detection using Python, NLP, and predictive modeling techniques.

Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures using Large Language Models, embeddings, semantic search, and vector databases to build intelligent document retrieval and decisionsupport systems.

Build end-to-end data science pipelines including data preprocessing, exploratory data analysis (EDA), feature engineering, model training, and evaluation using algorithms such as Logistic Regression, Random Forest, XGBoost, and Isolation Forest.
Develop scalable AI-powered APIs and microservices using FastAPI, Docker, and AWS, enabling real-time fraud risk scoring, financial insights generation, and patient clinical data summarization. 1

Improve business outcomes by implementing advanced model evaluation and monitoring techniques including Precision, Recall, F1-score, AUC, KS statistics, retrieval accuracy, and latency optimization to ensure reliable and production-ready AI systems.
Designed and implemented enterprise-grade RAG-based Generative AI solutions for healthcare use cases using secure, closed-source LLMs.
Owned end-to-end GenAI and data science workflows, including data preprocessing, embedding generation, and LLM integration for clinical insights.
Built and optimized patient-specific RAG pipelines leveraging semantic search to deliver accurate, contextgrounded clinical summaries.
Applied machine learning and NLP techniques to clean, normalize, and structure EHR and unstructured clinical text data.

Performed prompt engineering, retrieval tuning, and system evaluation using retrieval accuracy, response relevance, and latency metrics, and deployed solutions via FastAPI-based production APIs with privacycompliant workflows.
Containerized the application using Docker and prepared it for scalable cloud deployment. Outcomes:
Reduced clinical chart review time by 60% +.
Improved clinician productivity and faster decision-making.
Minimized LLM hallucinations through retrieval-grounded responses.
Enhanced accuracy and completeness of patient history insights.

Enabled scalable foundation for AI-driven clinical decision support. Tech Stack: Python, SQL, Pandas, NumPy, Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing (NLP) Large Language Models (LLMs–Closed Source), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Embeddings, Semantic Search, Vector Databases (Pinecone), Prompt Engineering, Prompt Guardrails, Hallucination Mitigation, Context Grounding, FastAPI REST APIs, Docker, AWS(Secure Cloud), Data Privacy and Compliance (HIPAA-aligned), Model
Designed and implemented an enterprise-scale Multi-Source RAG system for financial analytics, compliance, and executive decision-support use cases.
Performed data understanding and preprocessing on structured financial datasets (SQL, CSV) and unstructured sources (PDFs, reports). 2
Built scalable data pipelines including chunking, embedding generation, metadata enrichment, and semantic retrieval using vector databases.
Engineered prompt templates and guardrails to ensure accurate financial reasoning, KPI summaries, and source-grounded LLM responses.
Integrated closed-source LLMs into production APIs using FastAPI, and evaluated system performance using precision, recall, relevance, and latency metrics. Outcomes:
Reduced manual financial analysis and reporting effort by 60% +.
Improved insight accuracy through grounded, source-based LLM responses.
Enabled self-service financial querying for business and leadership users.
Strengthened compliance and audit readiness with traceable explanations.

Increased operational efficiency by minimizing dependency on manual data interpretation. Tech Stack: Python, SQL, Pandas, NumPy, Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing (NLP) Large Language Models (LLMs–Enterprise), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Embeddings, Semantic Search, Vector Databases (Pinecone), Prompt Engineering, Prompt Guardrails, Context Grounding, Chunking Strategies, Metadata Enrichment, FastAPI, REST APIs, Docker, AWS(Secure Cloud), Data Security and Compliance, Model
Analyzed large-scale digital payment transaction data to identify fraud patterns, anomalies, and high-risk behaviors across multiple channels.
Performed data cleaning, EDA, and advanced feature engineering on behavioral, velocity, geo-location, and device fingerprinting features.
Developed and optimized fraud detection models using Logistic Regression, Random Forest, XGBoost, and Isolation Forest with threshold tuning to control false positives.
Evaluated model performance using Precision, Recall, F1-score, AUC, and KS statistics, aligning model outcomes with business risk objectives.
Deployed scalable fraud risk scoring services via FastAPI-based REST APIs on cloud infrastructure and monitored performance using drift and stability checks. Outcomes:
Improved fraud detection recall by 30% while maintaining controlled false positive rates.
Improved customer satisfaction by 38%.
Enabled near real-time fraud risk scoring for transaction blocking and step-up authentication.
Reduced financial losses through early fraud identification and prevention.
Decreased manual review effort and operational costs using automated fraud screening.

Enhanced platform security, customer trust, and regulatory compliance. Tech Stack: Python and SQL, Pandas, NumPy, machine learning, Anomaly Detection, Logistic Regression, Random Forest, XGBoost, and Isolation Forest, Feature Engineering, Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA), FastAPI and REST APIs, PostgreSQL/MySQL databases, Docker, Cloud Deployment (AWS), Model Monitoring, Data Drift Detection, Model Evaluation (Precision, Recall, F1-Score, AUC, KS), Power BI, Tableau 3
